summary: @tpdt Parse my poems and you will find I am no heathen used a date format for antiquated cretins anyone who finds warmth in the order of knowledge has the knowledge to order time orderly #clmooc #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@tpdt
Parse my poems
and you will find I am no heathen
used a date format for
antiquated cretins
anyone who finds warmth in
the order of knowledge
has the knowledge to order time
orderly
#clmooc
#poetryport
